name: Rebbec
description: Glacian's wife and chief architect, who brought Yawgmoth back, loved him, and later closed the portal to Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: After the war the Phyrexians are trapped on Phyrexia when Rebbec closes the portal.
timeline.quote: when the Thran architect Rebbec closed the portal connecting Phyrexia to Dominaria

citation.text: "Gix", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec recombines the stones to close the portal and seals Yawgmoth in Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: his wife Rebbec discovered Yawgmoth's evil nature and recombined the two halves to close the portal Dyfed had created, sealing him in Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "The Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec seals the portal to Phyrexia, locking Yawgmoth out for millennia as Halcyon falls.
timeline.quote: Rebbec managed to seal the portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia, locking Yawgmoth out for millennia.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Thran Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec and Glacian seal the portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia at the Caves of Koilos, blocking invasion for five millennia.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Glacian transfused his being into two halves of a powerstone that was used by his wife, Rebbec , to seal off the connection

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Plotting Dominaria's downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Kyren, once guardians of Thran council members, grow corrupt and become allies of Phyrexia and Rath.
timeline.quote: They are the descendants of a group of Goblins from Dominaria during the time of the Thran who were left in Mercadia

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Kyren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth becomes convinced his true foe is Rebbec's spirit as the worldsoul Gaea.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth became convinced that his ultimate foe was not Urza

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glacian is stabbed with a powerstone by Gix during a riot in the Mana Rig and falls ill; Rebbec recalls the exiled Yawgmoth to heal him.
timeline.quote: His wife Rebbec uses her influence as the city's main architect to recall the exiled eugenicist Yawgmoth

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 1: The City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Delegates of the allied nations denounce Yawgmoth's atrocities; he survives a tied council vote, then overthrows the council and imprisons the elders and delegates.
timeline.quote: After this, Yawgmoth overthrows the council and imprisons its elders, as well as the delegates.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 3: The World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed sends the captured elders to Mercadia at Rebbec's summons, at Glacian's urging.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker brings them to Mercadia , along with about two hundred of their goblin servants.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 3: The World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glacian dies; Rebbec finds the powerstone halves Yawgmoth hid inside him, and she disguises her love for Yawgmoth as hatred.
timeline.quote: she disguises her love for Yawgmoth as hatred.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 4: The Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec frees Glacian's body, kills the vat priests, and gives Dyfed the peace of death.
timeline.quote: giving Dyfed the peace of death as well.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 4: The Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Thran Temple falls to the death cloud, and Yawgmoth persuades Halcyon's remaining inhabitants to flee to Phyrexia, where they are killed and made into newts.
timeline.quote: they try to flee again but are killed and used to create new Phyrexian newts .

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 4: The Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec reunites the powerstone, hears Glacian's voice, and places it on the pedestal to close the portal, locking Yawgmoth out of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: She goes to the pedestal room and does that, even though Yawgmoth pleads her not to from the other side of the portal.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 4: The Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec walks out of the Caves into the white cloud covering Halcyon.
timeline.quote: Rebbec ascends the stairs out of the Caves of the Damned and walks into the white cloud covering Halcyon.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 4: The Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth is recalled to Halcyon when Rebbec seeks a cure for Glacian's disease.
timeline.quote: Glacian's wife Rebbec used her influence as chief architect to bring Yawgmoth back

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Delegates declare war on Yawgmoth's supporters; Yawgmoth and Rebbec cast the tie-breaking votes, and Yawgmoth overthrows the council.
timeline.quote: He immediately overthrew the council and imprisoned its elders, as well as the delegates.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Thran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth stabs Dyfed with a powerstone dagger and Rebbec mercy-kills her.
timeline.quote: Rebbec removed the powerstone however, mercy-killing Dyfed.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Thran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec closes the portal between Phyrexia and Dominaria, locking Yawgmoth out.
timeline.quote: locking Yawgmoth and his followers out for all eternity.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Thran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec used her influence to have Yawgmoth return from exile to cure Glacian.
timeline.quote: Rebbec used her influence to have the eugenicist Yawgmoth return from exile.

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth and Rebbec began falling in love without acting on it.
timeline.quote: Rebbec and Yawgmoth started falling in love, although neither of them acted upon it.

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth overthrew the council and imprisoned its elders and the delegates after the vote on his stay split evenly.
timeline.quote: He immediately overthrew the council and imprisoned its elders, as well as the delegates.

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed cracked a powerstone to open a permanent portal from Dominaria to Phyrexia, and Rebbec built an infirmary there.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Dyfed cracked a powerstone to open a permanent portal from Dominaria to Phyrexia

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth merged himself with Rebbec on Phyrexia and proposed they rule together; she refused.
timeline.quote: Rebbec refused him.

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec found Dyfed stabbed in the skull for vivisection and removed the knife, letting her die.
timeline.quote: The disgusted Rebbec removed the knife, allowing Dyfed to die

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec returned to find Glacian dead and Halcyon devastated by Yawgmoth's cloud of energy.
timeline.quote: She found Glacian dead and discovered the powerstones Yawgmoth had implanted in him.

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec placed the powerstone on the pedestal to seal Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians away from Dominaria, then ascended into the white cloud.
timeline.quote: This would seal Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians away from their home plane of Dominaria.

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Rebbec's behest the Elder Council recalls Yawgmoth, who diagnoses phthisis.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth ultimately diagnosed the illness as phthisis

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Unrest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec and Yawgmoth narrowly defeat the Alliance's ultimatum, then Yawgmoth overthrows the council and declares martial law.
timeline.quote: Immediately thereafter, Yawgmoth overthrew the council entirely and declared martial law.

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Almost all the Thran are killed or flee to Phyrexia; Rebbec closes the portal.
timeline.quote: the portal to that plane was then closed in a final defiant act by Rebbec.

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After a tied vote Rebbec and Yawgmoth vote he may stay, and Yawgmoth overthrows the council.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth overthrew the council and imprisoned all elders and Alliance delegates

citation.text: "Thran-Phyrexian War", section "Declaration of War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec closes the portal before dying, locking Yawgmoth out.
timeline.quote: Rebbec had closed the portal to Phyrexia in the last moments before the cloud killed her

citation.text: "Thran-Phyrexian War", section "The aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legacy's light destroys Yawgmoth's black essence, ending his reign.
timeline.quote: destroying his black essence utterly and finally ending his millennia-long reign of terror.

citation.text: "Black Cloud of Death", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth sedates Rebbec, takes her to Phyrexia and invades her mind.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth sedated her and brought them both to Phyrexia

citation.text: "Battle of Halcyon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glacian dies and his spark powers the heartstone, letting Rebbec close the portal to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Rebbec was able to close the portal to Phyrexia, leaving her to face the white cloud of death alone

citation.text: "Battle of Halcyon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Yawgmoth seizes the empire, Dyfed takes the imprisoned elders to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Dyfed agreed to help Glacian, and took the elders, along with several goblin servants, to the plane of Mercadia

citation.text: "Dyfed", section "Creating the portal to Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec finds the tortured Dyfed and kills the priests working on her, allowing her to die.
timeline.quote: Rebbec found the tortured planeswalker and killed the priests working on her, allowing Dyfed to finally die.

citation.text: "Dyfed", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth claims Gaea was Rebbec.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth believed she was, in fact Rebbec

citation.text: "Gaea", section "Character development". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix stabs Glacian with a powerstone, giving him phthisis; Rebbec recalls Yawgmoth from exile to heal him.
timeline.quote: Rebbec , used her influence in the council to recall the healer Yawgmoth from his exile

citation.text: "Glacian", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth, in love with Rebbec, banishes Glacian to the Caves of the Damned and secretly replaces the stone sliver with the two halves of Dyfed's powerstone; the radiation kills Glacian.
timeline.quote: The radiation of these stones killed him, but his essence was trapped inside them

citation.text: "Glacian", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Clear-minded, Glacian's essence convinces Rebbec to unify the halves and close the portal to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: he convinced Rebbec to unify the halves and use them to close the portal to Phyrexia forever

citation.text: "Glacian", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec recalls Yawgmoth from exile; he finds phthisis is caused by powerstone radiation.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth is recalled from exile by Rebbec to cure Glacian.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Thran", section "c. -5115 to -5000 AR". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth overthrows the Elder Council and prepares for war after the Thran Alliance demands his removal.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth overthrows the Elder Council and starts to prepare for war.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Thran", section "c. -5115 to -5000 AR". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth defeats the Thran Alliance and wipes out Thran cities, but Rebbec closes the portal trapping him in Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: but Rebbec closes the portal from Dominaria to Phyrexia with Yawgmoth and his followers are trapped on the other side.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Thran", section "c. -5115 to -5000 AR". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
